relevance.rationale: This is the pionless-EFT derivation the corpus's Tjon infrastructure asserts but does not cite. QOU.MassTheory.TjonSimplexForm's docstring states outright: 'Pionless EFT explains the empirical Tjon correlation between B(3H) and B(4He) by the absence of a four-nucleon force at leading order' — and that file contains ZERO '-- Ref:' lines, while grep of folio/schema/references.ts finds no pionless-EFT entry and no entry for the N3LO four-nucleon estimate the same docstring quotes. The uploaded document is exactly that derivation: it constructs the LO effective interaction for large-scattering-length systems, shows an SU(4)-symmetric one-parameter three-nucleon interaction suffices to renormalise the four-nucleon system, and concludes that the absence of a four-nucleon force at LO is what generates the Tjon line, which is traced out by varying the three-body parameter. That is the literature premise underneath the corpus's mu4 argument (mu4 = 0 iff M(4) = 4M(3) - 6M(2); a nonzero mu4 measures non-additivity, not a four-body force) and underneath gap10_tjon_correlation_probe.py's use of the Tjon correlation as a convention-free 3-body/4-body score. Load-bearing and uncited: core. Explicitly NOT an aid-proof: the corpus's Lean identities (tjon_deviation_eq_mu4, mu4_eq_zero_iff_tjon) are simplex bookkeeping and already sorry-free, so nothing here discharges a Lean goal — what is missing is the -- Ref: header for the premise those identities are interpreted against.

keyResults.locator: Abstract; Summary (p. 8, 'The empirically observed correlation ... follows immediately from the absence of a four-nucleon force at leading order in l/|a|. The Tjon line is generated by variation of the three-body parameter.')
keyResults.statement: At leading order in l/|a| no four-nucleon force is needed to renormalise the four-body system; the Tjon line is the one-parameter family swept out by the three-body parameter.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies the cited premise for TjonSimplexForm's framing that a large negative mu4 is a simplex-basis artifact rather than four-body physics; currently that premise is stated in a Lean docstring with no -- Ref: at all.

keyResults.statement: With B_d = 2.22 MeV as input the LO calculation predicts B_alpha = 29.5 MeV (26.9 MeV with the alternative two-body input), against the Coulomb-corrected experimental 29.0 +/- 0.1 MeV.
keyResults.useForFolio: An external, parameter-counted LO prediction of the alpha binding from deuteron+triton inputs, directly comparable to the corpus's e2/e3/e4 per-order pinning on D/T/4He; a cross-check of the corpus's fractional Tjon deviation mu4/M(4) against a published LO value.

proposedActions.rationale: Core and orphan; TjonSimplexForm.lean quotes its result verbatim in prose with no citation.

Cross-check the corpus's fractional Tjon deviation mu4/M(4) against the LO-EFT Tjon slope and the B_alpha = 29.5 MeV prediction. The external number is a comparison target only and must not be adopted or fitted to.
